matrix_semantics: Compatibility refers to model-sensitivity configurations. UNKNOWN remains UNKNOWN; it is never promoted to AUTHORIZED.

rules.pair: One authorized endpoint/reference member with all other parameters at reference
rules.basis: B6N8-L defines separately identified one-factor sensitivity cases.

rules.pair: TSURF_LOW / TSURF_REFERENCE / TSURF_HIGH within the TSurf axis
rules.basis: Explicit B6N8-L axis; mutually exclusive values within one scenario.

rules.pair: Multiple distinct values from one scalar axis in one member
rules.basis: One semantic configuration binds one value per dimension.

rules.pair: Continental q by exact thermal class and matching support
rules.basis: Authored field values by class, not a global scenario axis.

rules.pair: HWR-2 configuration on admitted finite positive-age ocean support
rules.basis: B6N8-L age/support adapter and HWR validity; ocean support remains optional.

rules.pair: HWR-2 on 1,072 unresolved ocean cells or 108 age-zero ridge cells
rules.basis: Explicit fail-closed exclusions; no fallback or age-zero HWR.

rules.pair: Coherent k/rho/Cp tuple and derived kappa=k/(rho*Cp)
rules.basis: B6N8-I/N tuple semantics; kappa is not an independent scenario axis.

rules.pair: One-factor role endpoint on support with exact valid role join
rules.basis: B6N8-L conditional role/support applicability; exact support IDs not bound.

rules.pair: TSurf alternatives applied across continental and ocean support
rules.basis: B6N8-I limits use to matching datum/physical surface boundary; no qualified scenario-to-support map; ocean is optional.

rules.pair: Every scenario applies to all 63,620 metadata-admitted support cells
rules.basis: P retains symbolic 63,620×N; L makes ocean optional; Q preflight is metadata-only.

rules.pair: TSurf alternative jointly combined with A_C/A_M or material/HWR endpoint
rules.basis: L disallows invented joint combinations/correlations; P disallows unauthorized Cartesian products. No specific joint member is named.

rules.pair: Independent A_C alternatives for continental and ocean crust joined into one multi-role member
rules.basis: Role identities exist; no joint configuration identity/correlation/support map is authorized.

rules.pair: A_M endpoint combined with A_C or k/rho/Cp/alpha/Tb/zp/rho_w endpoint
rules.basis: Only separate one-factor cases are authorized; cross-axis combinations are not.

rules.pair: Fixed gravity, world T0 age, selected initializer and class-boundary inputs with an otherwise applicable one-factor member
rules.basis: Fixed parents are not additional scenario axes.

rules.pair: Held TSurf or A_C/A_M scenario interpreted as physical history
rules.basis: B6N8-L says model-boundary/source configuration only; physical history remains UNKNOWN.

rules.pair: Buck section, Ux, Xe, XL, strain rate or mechanics in a T0 initializer roster
rules.basis: B6N8-F is separate; Buck inputs/mechanics are not selected or executed.

remaining_gaps: continental-only versus optional ocean run scope
whether each allowed endpoint/config is resolvable through eventual provider binding
conclusion: Compatibility policy is sufficient to reject implicit products, but not to enumerate an executable roster.
